credits: Original geometry drawn for Verdant Reach under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md). Botanical reference: Gloriosa superba, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gloriosa_superba . No sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. Gloriosa superba. COILED: a forked, rust-brown tuber lying on the ground like an upturned V (the two planted feet); from the fork a climbing green shoot rises in an S, with alternate lance-shaped leaves whose tips run out into coiling tendrils, and its top pulled back over the body and curled into a big tendril spiral. Gesture: the tendril curls (the coil loosens and reaches for the foe, then whips tight, holds and settles); the tuber, shoot and leaves stay fixed. A flame-red dark slot (the tepals, the tuber's rust, the leaf shade) under a yellow-green mid (the tepals' wavy edges, the stamens, the leaves and shoot). Sport: the all-yellow form, Gloriosa superba 'Lutea'.
